build.front: plastic (inner screen), Gorilla Glass Victus 2 (6.3 inch cover screen)

software.os: Android 14, One UI 6.1.1, upgradable to Android 17

camera.reason: 50MP OIS main and a 10MP 3x telephoto with OIS, plus a 12MP ultrawide.

performance.reason: Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 for Galaxy is a previous generation flagship chip that still runs every game smoothly.

battery.reason: 4,400mAh gives a full day of use but charges at only 25W.

display.reason: 7.6 inch foldable LTPO AMOLED at 2,600 nits plus a 6.3 inch 120Hz cover screen.

build.reason: Aluminium frame and Victus 2 glass, but the inner screen is plastic and IP48 offers little dust protection.

value.reason: At 470,000 it is the cheapest PTA book style foldable in stock, though its 2024 cameras and battery trail the Xiaomi 17 Ultra at a similar price.

availability.reason: In stock at PriceOye and sold by Samsung Pakistan, with official Samsung service centres.

notes: PriceOye lists the 12GB 512GB at 469,999 in stock on 2026-10-11. Samsung Pakistan sells the Fold6 but its page did not show a price to our checker; WhatMobile lists 604,999. The display figures are for the inner screen. The front camera is the 10MP cover screen camera; the inner screen has a 4MP under display camera. Galaxy Z Fold7 and Fold8 are only listed non-PTA in Pakistan, so they are not on the site.
